test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following questions a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with correct idiom or phrase.

He is known for **talking too frankly**.

options.text: Snug as a bug in a rug

solution:
The correct answer is "**call a spade a spade"**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate idiom which means "**talking too frankly**" is "**call a spade a spade**".
 
• **Call a spade a spade** - speak plainly without leaving out anything. 
 
 
• **Example:** *The stand-up comedian was very honest. He **called a spade a spade**. *
 
 
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lose one's marbles** - become insane.

 
 
• **Example:** *John **lost his marbles** during the fight.*
 
 
 
• **Go the extra mile** - take extra effort.
 
 
• **Example:** *Mary **went the extra mile** to buy a present for her parents. *
 
 
 
• **Snug as a bug in a rug** - in a very comfortable situation. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Jim was **snug as a bug in a rug** in the debate. *
